stress_tests.label: pre_engine_fix_descriptive_raw_price
stress_tests.note: EW buy-and-hold of the formation basket from adjusted daily returns; limit/halt days keep raw return; |r|>35% nulled upstream

engine_dependency.reason: Engine books limit-up/limit-down/halt days as 0 return (block_mark_to_zero) — Strategy/Eng fixing

st.fallback: tushare_namechange_pit (only if table missing / session before table start)
st.rule: exclude if is_st_at_open on session (Data table, 2026-10-10 fix); disagreements vs namechange/panel reported

low_price.rationale: 2x the 1 CNY face-value delisting line (20 consecutive sessions <1 CNY)

non_standard_audit_opinion.rule: latest annual (end_date month 12) audit opinion with available_at date < session; exclude if is_non_standard
non_standard_audit_opinion.lookback_why: most recent annual report; ignore opinions older than FY(session.year-2) as stale (e.g. on 2026-03 before FY2025 reports the FY2024 opinion applies)

dd_brake.nav_basis_why: Beta owns and can measure the sleeve's own NAV; book NAV mixes 510300/residual owned by Strategy. Book-level brake left for Strategy once the book is composed.
dd_brake.dd_limit_why: sleeve-level budget below the Mandate book gate (-28%); a 20% sleeve DD at T20 is ~4% of book
dd_brake.floor_why: card 68: >=20% base exposure to avoid the zero-exposure absorbing state
dd_brake.gamma: calibrated: 1/max(structural 2x limit-down loss of board mix, empirical worst 2-day EW loss in pre-start window)
dd_brake.execution: decide at close d, trade at close d+1 under fixed-engine fill rules
dd_brake.concave_objective: exposure map e(z)=floor+(1-floor)*clip(gamma*(1-(1-d)/z),0,1): continuous, monotone, concave on active region; no return target, no step ladder, never adds risk below a target

live_profile.min_name_weight_why: 0.5% of 600k = 3,000 CNY/name: 1.5x the 2,000 CNY min trade (room for drift/partial rebalance trades), 5 CNY min commission = 16.7bp one-way at worst; caps N at tier/0.005 (T10=20, T15=30, T20=40->30)
live_profile.selection: walk the same research ranking (same band/PE/PB/ST/low-price/audit filters); skip names whose 1 lot x buffer > per-name CNY and take the next
live_profile.retain_why: keep current holding if still eligible and within top 2xN of the ranking; 2x is where research turnover plateaus (4.3->2.9/yr) and live T10/T15/T20 turnover falls 5.9/6.1/4.6 -> 4.3/4.9/3.2; 3x adds little

survivorship_b1.terminal_rule: on delist during holding: mark once at last available close × (1+terminal_return); no invented post-delist prices
